# Friends of Notre-Dame de Paris

> > Official U.S. nonprofit supporting the restoration of Notre-Dame Cathedral following the 2019 fire, preserving 800 years of Gothic architecture and French cultural heritage.

Friends of Notre-Dame de Paris serves as the primary American fundraising organization for the cathedral's reconstruction, working closely with the Établissement Public and Chief Architect Philippe Villeneuve. The organization provides comprehensive updates on restoration progress, from the spire and transept to the Grand Organ and stained glass, while educating donors about Notre-Dame's Gothic architecture, artifacts, and historical significance.

## Key Topics

- Notre-Dame Cathedral restoration
- Gothic architecture preservation
- Cathedral reconstruction progress
- Spire and transept restoration
- Grand Organ restoration
- Stained glass conservation
- Philippe Villeneuve (Chief Architect)
- Établissement Public
- Eugène Viollet-le-Duc
- Cultural heritage preservation
- Oak timber reconstruction
- Cathedral artifacts and art
- Donation and fundraising
- Historical monuments conservation

## Support & Donate

- [Support Notre Dame's Restoration | Ways to give](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/donate): Main donation page for Notre-Dame restoration with multiple giving options
- [Save Notre Dame de Paris | Friends of Notre Dame de Paris](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/save-notre-dame-de-paris): Main fundraising campaign page for 800-year-old Notre-Dame Cathedral
- [How to donate to Notre Dame: 9 ways you can help](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/how-to-donate-to-notre-dame): Complete guide to 9 donation methods including crypto and monthly giving

## Restoration Progress Updates

- [Notre-Dame Construction Progress Update](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/notre-dame-construction-progress-update): Latest updates on Notre-Dame Cathedral restoration by Établissement Public
- [Roofing of the transept and erection of scaffolding for the spire | Friends of Notre-Dame de Paris](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/roofing-of-the-transept-and-erection-of-scaffolding-for-the-spire): Transept lead roofing completion and spire scaffolding progress update
- [Repositioning the bells and restoring the North Belfry | Friends of Notre-Dame de Paris](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/repositioning-the-bells-and-restoring-the-north-belfry): North Belfry bell restoration and carpentry work by Cornille Harvard
- [Inside Notre-Dame's Restoration: CBS News | 60 Minutes](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/cbs-60-minutes-notre-dame-restoration): CBS 60 Minutes Bill Whitaker report on Notre-Dame restoration progress

## Cathedral Artifacts & Architecture

- [Discover the Majesty of Notre Dame's Grand Organ](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/cathedral/artifacts/grand-organ): 8,000-pipe Grand Organ history and post-fire restoration details
- [The Stained-Glass of Notre-Dame de Paris](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/the-stained-glass-of-notre-dame-de-paris): History and restoration of Notre-Dame's Gothic stained glass windows
- [Meet the Magnificent Choir of Notre Dame](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/cathedral/artifacts/choir): Gothic choir architecture and sculptures of Notre-Dame Cathedral
- [Discover the Beauty of Notre Dame's Chapels](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/cathedral/artifacts/chapels): 13th-century radiating chapels with medieval artwork and tombs
- [Meet the Mystical Figures of Notre Dame's Grotesques](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/cathedral/artifacts/grotesques): Viollet-le-Duc's 19th-century grotesques including Le Stryge gargoyle

- [Generous Gift Brings Notre-Dame's Baptismal Font and Choir Organ Back to Life | Friends of Notre-Dame de Paris](https://www.friendsofnotredamedeparis.org/generous-gift-brings-notre-dames-baptismal-font-and-choir-organ-back-to-life): Edouard Eisele memorial gift restores baptismal font and choir organ
